message.content: {"7004_8353800850538": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The chest X-ray (Figure 1a) shows a left-sided opacity with volume loss and mediastinal shift to the left, while the CT (Figure 3a) confirms a central mass obstructing the airway with associated collapse, consistent with tumor obstruction."}, "7004_8353800850883": {"answer": "A", "reason": "Comparing Figure 1a to Figure 1b and 4a, there is a marked reduction in the mediastinal mass size and resolution of the left lower lobe collapse, resulting in normalization of the mediastinal position."}, "7004_8353801540368": {"answer": "E", "reason": "The follow-up images show significant reduction of both the mediastinal mass and the left lower lobe collapse with clear lung fields, a rapid and complete response characteristic of non-Hodgkin's lymphoma treated with chemotherapy."}, "7004_8353801559797": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The dramatic improvement in symptoms and radiographic findings corresponds to the clearance of the bulky mediastinal mass seen in the initial presentation, which was compressing adjacent structures."}}
